reason: E1 directly states that tailored thermo-mechanical processing of an AlCoCrFeNi2.1 EHEA engineers an ultrafine-grained duplex microstructure inheriting the lamellar nature, achieving improved strength–ductility synergy. E2 confirms that cold-rolling and annealing of the same alloy increases strength to 1.2 GPa with 12% elongation, and cryo-rolling plus annealing yields 1.47 GPa with 14% elongation, supporting the simultaneous enhancement claim. The cited evidence accurately represents the key premises.
premises: Severe cold rolling followed by annealing refines the lamellar microstructure of eutectic HEAs into an ultrafine hierarchical duplex architecture.
This microstructural refinement simultaneously increases yield strength and ductility relative to the as-cast state.
The mechanism involves increased dislocation density, grain refinement, selective phase decomposition, and a high density of interphase boundaries that impede dislocations and distribute strain.
